text.config.signed32.title: Signed32 Settings
text.config.signed32.option.expandWorldB: Removes the vanilla ±30,000,000 border limit and extends it to the signed 32-bit integer range (±2.14 billion).
text.config.signed32.option.fixChunkOver: Prevents integer overflow when converting chunk coordinates to block coordinates and unlocks valid chunk boundaries beyond vanilla limits.
text.config.signed32.option.farLandsNois: Ports Beta 1.7.3 noise overflow to generate towering sky walls and swiss cheese caverns beyond 12.55M.
text.config.signed32.option.farLandsThre: Coordinate threshold where the Far Lands wall begins to generate (Default: 12,550,821).
text.config.signed32.option.expandBlockP: Bypasses the vanilla 64-bit packed long limit (±33.5M blocks) using hash tables for full 32-bit integer coordinates.
text.config.signed32.option.expandSectio: Removes SectionPos 22-bit packing limitations, enabling section indexing beyond ±2,097,152 sections.
text.config.signed32.option.expandEntity: Restructures entity spatial indexing to align with SectionPos hashing, preventing entity loading drops or crashes in extreme coordinates.
text.config.signed32.option.extendedBloc: ⚠️ Requires Signed32 on both client and server. Disable this feature when joining standard servers (Purpur/Paper/Vanilla).
text.config.signed32.option.cameraJitter: Degrades camera coordinates to 32-bit float, recreating the classic stepwise viewpoint jitter.
text.config.signed32.option.entityJitter: Snaps entity rendering to the single-precision grid, keeping entities in sync with world stutter.
text.config.signed32.option.blockTearing: Recreates vertex tearing and distortion on non-full block models (e.g. redstone wire, torches, rails).
text.config.signed32.option.jitterThresh: Absolute coordinate distance where visual effects begin to take effect (Default: 12,550,821).
